name: hypotize
description: Growth OS for AI agents: idea backlog, experiment pipeline and learning library shared by the team and the agent. The agent checks what the team already tested, writes hypothesis-first ideas, scores them with ICE, PIE or RICE and closes each test with a measured result and a learning. Hosted server with OAuth 2.1; the server enforces the experiment stages.

examples.title: Check past tests
examples.description: Find what the team already tested on a topic
examples.prompt: What have we already tested on onboarding emails, and what did we learn?

examples.title: Propose an experiment
examples.description: Write a scored, hypothesis-first idea without duplicates
examples.prompt: Propose an experiment to raise trial-to-paid conversion and score it with ICE. Check the backlog for duplicates first.

examples.title: Weekly review
examples.description: Find tests waiting for a verdict or past their due date
examples.prompt: Run a weekly review of the growth pipeline: which tests are waiting for a verdict and which are past their due date?
